tiers.req: Six Premium Runes and the first three rune sockets bought: the PRE runeword is active (3,600 gems).
Daily Fate Spiral bought on reaching Act 3 (900 gems, saved in advance).
Engineer Slot Upgrades bought as each resource unlocks (1,250 gems).
Remaining rune sockets bought as you build runewords (4,500 gems).
Hourglass Generator Speed at level 2 or more.
Extra Rift Worker bought (700 gems), after the Golden Rift timeline upgrade.

tables.title: Gem rules
rows: Tiers follow the Gem Guide's buy order, except that Daily Fate Spiral (its #2) sits third here because it cannot be bought before Act 3.
Buy three Premium Runes, then alternate: 4th rune and 1st socket, 5th rune and 2nd socket, 6th rune and 3rd socket.
Keep 900 gems saved before entering Act 3. A chest costs 80 gems, so the upgrade pays for itself in about 12 days.
The rest of the Upgrades tab can be skipped. Do not buy ash generation.
The daily quest gives 60 gems and many achievements pay 30.

A pet stat reroll (Tier 5-6 pets only) costs gems; the price rises with pet tier (EvitaniaOnlineDB's calculator uses 200 gems at Tier V). Unverified until checked in game. A Class Reset Brew (talent reset) costs 30 and a gathering Mining Reset Potion 100. Prefer account boosts.
Hourglass dragons past level 7 have Dragon Milestones, a new gem sink.
Extra boss keys can be bought for gems, up to six a day.
